evidence: PDF p. 96 (printed 94), verse 621 half b shows «ابْنِ العَلَا» completely in red ink (including the final alif in the لا ligature) followed by a black comma «،»; Wafi b621 confirms the code refers to أبو عمرو (ابن العلاء).
reasoning: In half b (سِوَى ⟦R2 «ابْنِ العَلَ»⟧،ا مَن يَرۡتَدِدۡ ⟦R4 «عَمَّ»⟧ مُرْسَلَا), the comma was misplaced before the final alif of «العَلَا», truncating the red span R2 at «ابْنِ العَلَ» and leaving «،ا» outside the span.
